title: Occupation-selective topological pumping from Floquet gauge fields
summary: Topological pumping is conventionally governed by single-particle band topology. Here we show that promoting tunneling to a dynamical, occupation-conditioned variable fundamentally reshapes this paradigm, leading to occupation-selective topological pumping. In a periodically driven one-dimensional superlattice with density-dependent hopping, two-body bound states (doublons) acquire Chern numbers distinct from those of single particles and exhibit quantized transport even when the single-particle pump is trivial, including counter-propagating responses.
